title: Back Pain, Joint Pain & Arthritis (Sandhivata / Katishoola) — Dual-System Monograph
content:
Condition: Back Pain (Lumbago), Joint Pain & Osteoarthritis (Sandhivata).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Paracetamol 650mg or Diclofenac / Ibuprofen gel (topical NSAID) applied 3-4 times daily. Oral Etoricoxib 60-90mg or Aceclofenac 100mg + Paracetamol (Rx with food). Vitamin D3 & Calcium supplementation.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Yograj Guggulu or Maha Yograj Guggulu (2 tablets twice daily after meals with warm water). Shallaki (Boswellia serrata 500mg). Mahanarayan Oil or Dhanwantharam Oil warm massage (Abhyanga).
Home Remedies: Hot/Cold fermentation packs, Turmeric Golden Milk with pinch of dry ginger (Sunthi), Gentle spinal stretching and pelvic tilt exercises.
Red Flags: Back pain with numbness/weakness in legs or loss of bowel/bladder control (Cauda Equina syndrome - emergency 112).
